Introduction

JUN0 is a South Korean solo artist. He officially debuted on April 5, 2023, with the single "Honestly, I Don’t Need Love Anymore" under the label DIPBLU.

Known for his versatility, JUN0 explores a wide range of genres and is recognized for creating youthful, engaging melodies that appeal to a broad audience. His music blends elements of R&B, soul, and indie, featuring a light vocal tone and memorable, catchy lyrics.
